@Gideon Sato: according to the channel record, you first reported the kiosks offline at **10:42 AM on 3 Aug**: "gate kiosks offline at Vantorre's Hartford plant," with both inbound lanes showing a white screen after badge scan.

The channel only records one guard activity in that window. At 10:42 you wrote that the guard was writing trailer numbers on a clipboard. Mateo reported at 11:03 that the guard had checked in trailer 8836 and that dispatch could see it, after kiosk 1 came back. Nothing else in the channel describes the guard between those times, so if the postmortem needs more detail, Mateo or the gate's shift log would be the place to check.
